theme: cheapest clockwork that visits every gear tooth
title: Cheapest Clockwork: A Long Cycle That Still Remembers Its Anchors
strategies: textbook Hull-Dobell full-cycle translation, patched via from-scratch Lagrange interpolation of the small CRT factor plus the un-simplified weighted-idempotent CRT recombination (trivial)

correct CRT split (identity on the small factor, primitive-root map with one fixed point on the large factor) glued together with the literal textbook weighted-idempotent sum, never algebraically simplified (greedy)
same CRT split, but folded: since both per-factor maps are affine, the whole reconstruction collapses to ONE global affine map -- 2 instructions regardless of |S| or n (strong)
sub-2-instruction constructions, or maps whose per-factor pieces are non-affine yet still cheap, remain open (uncovered ceiling)
